query: Bare printed circuit boards HTS 8534 import duties

statements.text: The rate depends on product classification, country of origin, entry date, Chapter 99 treatment, and whether a valid exclusion applies.
CBP has issued rulings where a bare PCB from China was classified under 8534.00.0040, with the base duty listed as free and an additional China Section 301 duty noted unless excluded.
Is there one fixed PCB tariff China 2026 rate? No. The rate depends on product classification, country of origin, entry date, Chapter 99 treatment, and whether a valid exclusion applies.

The merchandise under consideration is a bare printed circuit board (PCB), P/N: LED SW Rev 4. It is comprised of a rigid insulating substrate (board) with printed circuit pathways (printed circuitry). This PCB does not incorporate any additional electrical elements or components, it is an unpopulated PCB. The PCB is made from FR-4 glass reinforced epoxy laminate material.
Bare printed circuits are commonly reviewed under HTS heading 8534, but actual classification depends on construction and use.
Many bare printed circuits are reviewed under HTS heading 8534, but final classification depends on the exact product.
If you import PCBs or PCB assemblies from China into the United States in 2026, do not treat “PCB tariff” as one fixed percentage.
For example, CBP ruling language for a China-origin bare PCB under 8534.00.0040 referenced an additional 25 percent ad valorem duty under Chapter 99 unless excluded

Bare printed circuit boards have their own heading, 8534, which covers 'printed circuits'; boards with conductive tracks, but before electronic components are mounted. This is the home for the unpopulated PCB as manufactured.
